scrape-formats.screenshot.evidence: Implemented at ba5bdedf (branch claude/m2-formats on origin/main 914005c): formats 'screenshot' / { type: 'screenshot', quality, viewport } on scrape, batch, crawl, MCP and /fc; the request runs on the local browser rung alone and is refused by name where none is permitted. Live at ba5bdedf through the local API with debug true, HTTPS_PROXY 127.0.0.1:7890 (proxyUsed operator): S1 https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/co-emissions-per-capita?tab=table (test set #24) with viewport 1280x800 answered success on browser_local in 2,490 ms, channelsTried ['browser_local'], a PNG whose IHDR says 1280x800, 110,844 bytes equal to screenshot.bytes, sha256 of the decoded bytes equal to screenshot.sha256, 649 distinct sampled pixel values (not blank), screenshot_captured with the same size, the Markdown with 232 table rows; S3 https://www.energy-charts.info/?l=en&c=DE (#28) the same shape in 6,018 ms, 1,049 distinct values. Loopback fixtures: C3 quality 60 gives image/jpeg starting FF D8 (34,036 bytes); C4 viewport 800x600 gives an 800x600 PNG with screenshot_viewport in the trace and the declared desktop identity on the wire; C5 a 404 page is failed/http_error with its capture kept as evidence; C6 fastMode beside the format is HTTP 400 'screenshot requires the browser lane, which fastMode declines'. Tests: contracts api.test.ts, api app.test.ts (browser-only selection, the http-only refusal), bench pageOptions.test.ts on real Chromium. Record: research/parity/m2-formats-screenshot-live-checks-2026-10-02.md.

crawl-batch.sitemap-mode.evidence: 9274fe3: sitemap include|skip|only on REST, /fc (v1 ignoreSitemap and sitemapOnly mapped), SDK and MCP; HttpSitemapSource reads the robots.txt Sitemap lines or /sitemap.xml with the crawl's http identity, SSRF checks, proxy, scheduler pacing and the file's own robots.txt verdict, follows an index one level, inflates gzip, caps 20 files and maxPages entries; entries enter the frontier at depth 1 after the seed under a link's rules; the report's discovery.sitemap lists every file. Live A-D in m2-live-checks-crawl-urls-sitemap-2026-10-02.md: sitemaps.org only gives the seed plus 9 sitemap entries (file 200, urlset, 84 entries, sha256 recorded), include finds 9 pages the homepage does not link; gov.uk's 35-child index is followed into sitemap_1.xml (5.6 MB, 25,000 entries); webscraper.io's index then pages_sitemap.xml (133 entries), the pages being the first five non-seed locs; skip reads none. Known leftovers: sitemap fetches are spaced by the scheduler's interval, not the robots Crawl-delay; the w2l crawl CLI reads no sitemap; sitemap bodies are hashed, not saved. Tests: http-core sitemap.test.ts, bench sitemapSource.test.ts, runtime orchestrator.test.ts, api app.test.ts, contracts.

crawl-batch.crawl-max-concurrency.evidence: 9274fe3: maxConcurrency (integer >= 1) on REST, /fc, SDK and MCP, refused above the service's worker count ('maxConcurrency must be at most N on this service'; 4 locally, 2 on the hosted MCP host), stored with the task and kept on resume; the orchestrator runs min(workerCount, maxConcurrency) workers and the per-host gate stays. Live E: data.gov.uk/search?q=energy with maxConcurrency 1 fetched 5 /search pages whose fetch intervals never overlap (gaps 3,082, 0, 1, 2 ms); the books.toscrape.com control at 2 shows 5 overlapping pairs. Known leftover: the batch counterpart (crawl-batch.batch-max-concurrency) is not added; the CLI has no flag. Tests: runtime orchestrator.test.ts, api app.test.ts, contracts api.test.ts and firecrawl.test.ts, mcp tools.test.ts.

crawl-batch.crawl-active-list.evidence: 9274fe3: GET /v1/crawl/active (registered before the :id routes), SDK getActiveCrawls, MCP list_active_crawls (local host only): the engine's in-flight crawls with id, start URL, status, startedAt, pagesFetched and stored options, always 200, never a batch, no team id. Live F: two sandbox crawls (books.toscrape.com, quotes.toscrape.com, maxPages 20) both listed as running with their options; after the first completed only the second (pagesFetched 4); after both, {crawls: []} with HTTP 200. Known leftover: the list is one process's own crawls. Tests: api app.test.ts (route precedence, batch not listed), sdk client.test.ts, mcp tools.test.ts.

crawl-batch.auto-pagination.evidence: 9274fe3: SDK listCrawlPages / listBatchItems take maxPages, maxResults and maxWaitMs and return where they stopped (nextCursor, stoppedBy); each page is requested no larger than what is still wanted so the cursor continues exactly; getCrawlDocuments / getBatchDocuments merge status and documents, collectCrawlPages / collectBatchItems collect alone; MCP get_crawl_pages and get_batch_items take maxResults 1..200 and follow cursors themselves. Server page sizes unchanged. Live G: a 12-page docs.python.org/3/ crawl read with limit 5: maxResults 10 gives 10 distinct pages, stoppedBy maxResults, a cursor, 1 status and 2 page requests; maxPages 1 gives 10; maxWaitMs 1 gives 5 with stoppedBy maxWait; no caps gives 12 with stoppedBy end. Known leftover: the /fc status pages with next alone. Tests: sdk client.test.ts, mcp tools.test.ts.
